messages:
zoe: quick follow-up from the PM: we still have several open remedial items. main ask — clear owner lifecycle and an auto-escalation if an owner is AWOL.
ben: agreed. been burned by orphaned tickets. proposal: 1) assign R (owner) + A (approver), 2) if no updates in 7 days -> auto-escalate to oncall manager, 3) require 1-line acceptance criteria in Jira.
tara: +1. i'll take point on drafting the escalation text. also suggest adding an "interim owner" field for when R is OOO.
li: for recurring incidents we should have an "epic tracker" and a small dashboard. i'll create EPIC-9933 and a Grafana panel with a 90d error-trend. links in tickets.
ops-bot: EPIC-9933 created and assigned to li. Reminder set for 2026-05-01T09:00:00Z.
ben: process nit: require R to add ETA and acceptance criteria on assignment. acceptance criteria = reproduction steps OR test + smoke checks + rollback command. keeps closures fast.
tara: I'll draft a sample acceptance template: ```
AC: reproduce in staging; add metric + alert; PR + tests; canary 24h with <0.5% error rate.
Rollback: revert PR and run smoke-check.sh
```
zoe: nice. also add an audit log field in Jira (who closed + timestamp) for compliance.
li: doing that. also linking historical tickets to EPIC-9933 so we can spot recurrence frequency.
ben: on escalation: auto-assign to oncall-manager, add a Slack notif to #eng-oncall with the ticket link, and set a 48h SLA for acknowledgement.
tara: i'll add a short runbook snippet to the RACI doc with owner rotation rules: 2-week rotation, interim owner if >3 days OOO, auto-escalate after 7 days without update.
ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-05-04T10:30:00Z.
li: for the immediate list: RMD-9988 (cache TTL drift) -> R: li, A: ben, ETA Tue; RMD-9991 (autoscaler config) -> R: tara, A: zoe, canary Mon 09:00 UTC.
ben: i'll validate RMD-9988 once telemetry is added. tara — please add the canary steps in the ticket and include thresholds.
tara: added canary snippet to RMD-9991: ```
1) deploy config to 10% canary pool
2) monitor latency & error rate in 1m windows
3) abort if error >0.5% or latency > 2x baseline
```
zoe: great. final ask: who will own the RACI PR to include these rules? i'd like it merged this week.
tara: i'll open the PR and ping for review.
li: attaching dashboard draft: https://grafana.internal/d/epic-9933 (WIP). feedback welcome.
ben: thanks all. closing the loop — marking these items as "follow-up: owners assigned" and will watch the epic. :thumbsup:
